card.name: Preparation and storage instructions wording
card.fires_on: Small connecting words in label instructions about preparing solutions, keeping potency, and following procedures, such as 'maintains' before 'satisfactory potency' or 'to' before 'strict aseptic'. Also 'of' after 'provider' in education program text.

modes.label: Stability after reconstitution
modes.description: The verb 'maintains' right before 'satisfactory potency for N hours' in reconstituted-solution storage text.
modes.example: Storage When prepared with the diluent, ertapenem for injection<< maintains>> satisfactory potency for 6 hours at room

modes.label: Aseptic procedure wording
modes.description: Words in the phrase about adhering to strict aseptic procedures during kit preparation.
modes.example: It is essential that the user follow the directions carefully and adhere to<< strict>> aseptic procedures during preparation.

modes.label: Provider of education
modes.description: The word 'of' after 'accredited provider' in REMS education program text.
modes.example: Complete a REMS-compliant education program offered by an accredited provider<< of>> continuing education (CE) or another education
